name: jasx
description: JASX (Java with JSX-style markup): syntax highlighting, and errors, completion, go-to-definition and hover from the JASX language server.

jasx.languageServer.enabled.description: Run the JASX language server (errors while typing, completion, go-to-definition and hover on components). Needs Java 21 or later.

jasx.languageServer.java.description: The java executable that runs the language server. Empty: JAVA_HOME, then the Java extension's 'java.jdt.ls.java.home', then 'java' on the PATH.

jasx.target.description: The JASX target for files the build hasn't described yet (after a build with the JASX Gradle plugin, the project's own target is used).
